description.value:
You design additional custom arrays for your turret. Select two of the following arrays. Add the selected arrays to your list of available arrays.

  • 1d8 mental damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, mental weapon group

  • 1d8 poison damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, dart weapon group

  • 1d8 vitality damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, laser weapon group

  • 1d8 void damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, void weapon group

Special You can take this feat a second time. When you do, you must select different arrays.
